# TotemAlchemy

Survival alchemy with uncertain outcomes, personal research, and potion mixtures that respond to heat.

TotemAlchemy expands brewing with familiar Minecraft ingredients and containers. Experiment at a Brewing Stand, record discoveries in your Totem Manual, or cook mixtures in a cauldron over a lit Campfire.

## Brewing and research

- Brewing ingredients have different success rates. A successful effect ingredient can produce several effects in the same batch.
- Redstone, glowstone dust, gunpowder, and dragon's breath retain their roles in changing duration, potency, and potion delivery.
- Your research records effects you have actually discovered. Repeated experiments improve the processing-time estimates shown in the manual.
- Research is saved per player in the world and remains available when you replace your book or reconnect.

## Cauldron mixtures

- Ingredients react on their own schedules. A built-in crosshair display shows capacity and approximate stages such as “Almost there” and “Perfect”.
- Bottle an unfinished mixture and return it to the cauldron later to continue cooking.
- Each completed reaction has a short extraction window before continued heating can reduce stability. Finished potions are stabilized when bottled; pouring them back does not restart overcooking unless you begin another reaction.
- Large potion bottles hold up to three portions.

The mod also adds stone bowls, pig manure, wood ash, saltpeter, hot cocoa, Cherry Swiftness, and Firefly Strength. Server data packs can customize recipes, ingredient processing times, starter materials, and effect weights.

## Getting started

1. Install Fabric API, TotemCore, and TotemAlchemy on both the client and server.
2. Use a Book on a Brewing Stand to obtain or refresh the Alchemy chapter of the Totem Manual.
3. Experiment with brewing ingredients to discover effects and improve your research.
4. Place a lit Campfire beneath a cauldron and follow the recipes in the manual or project README.

## Requirements and documentation

For Minecraft 26.2 with Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer and Java 25. Fabric API and TotemCore `>=0.7.18 <0.8.0` are required. TotemCore is published on Modrinth as TotemLibrary. Other Totem gameplay modules are optional.

[Source code and detailed recipes](https://github.com/Yunitrish006006/TotemAlchemy) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/Yunitrish006006/TotemAlchemy/issues) · [TotemLibrary (TotemCore dependency)](https://modrinth.com/mod/totemlibrary)
